# iiq-helper — System Requirements
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# This is a documentation-only Agent Skill. There is no executable
# runtime, no compiled artifact, and nothing to import.
#
# DO NOT run `pip install`, `npm install`, `bundle install`, or any
# other package-manager command against this directory. There are no
# dependencies to resolve.
#
# To use the skill, just place this folder in a skills directory
# discovered by your AI agent (see README.md → Installation).
# --------------------------------------------------------------------


# REQUIRED — runtime (one of these agents must be installed)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Visual Studio Code        >= 1.99   (with GitHub Copilot Chat extension)
# GitHub Copilot CLI        >= 0.0.20 (any Agent Skills-compatible build)
# Claude Code               >= any    (reads SKILL.md natively)
# Any other agent that implements the Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io)


# REQUIRED — disk space
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# ~38 MB on disk
#   ~28 MB  references/JavaDocs/8.4   (IIQ 8.4 JavaDocs HTML, 793 classes)
#   ~10 MB  references/objects/8.4    (30 official IIQ 8.4 object guides as .txt)
#  < 50 KB  SKILL.md + recipes.md + navigation/standards docs


# REQUIRED — host OS
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Any OS supported by your chosen agent. The skill is pure Markdown +
# HTML reference content; no platform-specific binaries.


# OPTIONAL — only if you want to regenerate the bundled indices
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Used only by the one-time scripts in .tools/  (you almost certainly
# do not need this — the indices are committed to the repo).
#
# PowerShell                >= 5.1    (Windows PowerShell or PowerShell 7+)
#                                     for .tools/gen-class-manifest.ps1
#                                         .tools/gen-object-toc.ps1
#                                         .tools/split-big-guides.ps1


# NOT REQUIRED
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Python, Node.js, Java, a SailPoint IdentityIQ installation, network
# access, API keys, or any external service. The skill works entirely
# offline against the bundled reference files.
